response.original_title: [Add-Guest] Can You Add a Passenger to a Disney Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing Disney Cruise Line Official Website booking by calling Disney customer service directly +1-866-254-7549 or contacting your travel agent +1-866-254-7549, as additions cannot be processed online. Key Rules for Adding a Passenger No Online Changes: You cannot add a guest through the website +1-866-254-7549 or mobile app. You must call Disney +1-866-254-7549 or your travel advisor. Stateroom Capacity: Your room must be rated to hold the extra person physically (such as using a sofa bed or upper berth) +1-866-254-7549. If not, you must switch to a larger room if one is available. Ship and Lifeboat Limits: The overall ship capacity and the specific lifeboat/muster station limit must not be completely sold out +1-866-254-7549. Current Pricing: Adding a new guest means you will pay the prevailing fare +1-866-254-7549 and current taxes/fees for that person rather than the original booking rate.
